name: Tax Efficient Product
definition: Characteristics of a tax efficient product.

EstimatedValue.name: Estimated Value
EstimatedValue.definition: Estimated value of the assets of the tax efficient product to be transferred.

PreviousYears.name: Previous Years
PreviousYears.definition: Investment plans issued during previous years.

TaxCalculationBase.name: Tax Calculation Base
TaxCalculationBase.definition: Amount of money from which the tax deduction is calculated.

LowestInvestedAmountCurrentYear.name: Lowest Invested Amount Current Year
LowestInvestedAmountCurrentYear.definition: Lowest investment amount in the current year, used to calculate a tax deduction amount.

InvestorTaxReference.name: Investor Tax Reference
InvestorTaxReference.definition: Identification of the investor as assigned by a tax authority.

TaxEfficientProductType.name: Tax Efficient Product Type
TaxEfficientProductType.definition: Type of tax efficient product, for example, an individual savings account (ISA) in the UK.

AmountType.name: Amount Type
AmountType.definition: Specifies if it is a Bonus paid out or Withdrawn.

InvestmentsToFollowValue.name: Investments To Follow Value
InvestmentsToFollowValue.definition: Value of the investments to follow.

InvestorTaxReferenceType.name: Investor Tax Reference Type
InvestorTaxReferenceType.definition: Identification of the type of investor as assigned by a tax authority.

RelatedInvestmentPlan.name: Related Investment Plan
RelatedInvestmentPlan.definition: Investment plan to what the characteristics of the tax efficient product relate to.

CurrentYearSubscription.name: Current Year Subscription
CurrentYearSubscription.definition: Amounts already subscribed for the current year.
